stories.title: Passan's ultimate MLB trade deadline preview: Where all 30 teams stand, best fits and latest intel
stories.summary: From the contenders eyeing Tarik Skubal to the rebuilders, here's what every front office is thinking ahead of Monday's deadline.

stories.title: Deebo back to 49ers on 1-year deal, sources say
stories.summary: Free agent Deebo Samuel is signing back with the 49ers on a 1-year deal that could be worth up to $7 million, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Sources: Mets start dealing, ship Minter to Twins
stories.summary: The last-place Mets, in what could be the first of multiple deals, dealt left-handed relief pitcher A.J. Minter to the Twins for prospects Bruin Agbayani and Billy Amick, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.

stories.title: Saints' Olave signs extension worth up to $132M
stories.summary: The Saints are signing wide receiver Chris Olave to a four-year extension worth up to $132 million, including $90 million guaranteed, his agents Drew Rosenhaus and Jason Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sparks' Plum on trade speculation: 'It's business'
stories.summary: Five-time All-Star guard Kelsey Plum said she's "not taking anything personal" amid growing speculation that the Sparks could move her before Sunday's trade deadline
